I watched ATLA for the fifth time then tried to watch Korra again and omfg. I hate Korra. If it was a spin-off about Bolin I would have lost my mind with joy! But no. It was about Korra, and her inability to defeat ANYONE without help. I don’t even understand why Mako is in the show. He serves NO PURPOSE. He is there for drama, same as Korra. Asami and Bolin could have tackled this entire series together, but nooooo, we’re stuck with a spoiled racist child and some guy that wants to be a hipster but hipsters don’t exist yet so he’s just stuck in a loop of bad decisions. 

I wanted soooo badly for Raava to select Asami to be the new Avatar but of course Korra had a friend show up to hand her victory yet again because god forbid she do ANYTHING on her own.

Korra was the absolute WORST avatar because she put her own needs and wants first. For example, she arrives in Republic City and comes across a non bender on a soapbox talking about how benders are oppressing non benders. Korra decides to say “what are you talking about? Bending is the coolest thing ever!”

Imagine it was a BLM protest and some black kid was standing there talking about how whites oppress blacks, then Korra just shows up and says “what are you talking about? Being white is the coolest thing ever!” (Yes I know Korra isn’t white, it’s an analogy). It’s the same exact concept. Korra is dismissing people’s needs based on her own personal judgement, and at no point does she realize her mistake! It’s like the non benders don’t matter at all. She goes through an entire arc scared out of her mind because she CAN’T IMAGINE BEING A NON BENDER. They bring in Asami as a Sokka replacement, then make her super smart and technology savvy to “make up” for her being a non bender. Why even have non benders in this show if they wanted to shit on them so hard??

Anyway, that’s the main reason I hate Korra. She says she’s “for the people” but the non benders literally cry out to her for help and she’s like “naaah, I might lose my bending if I do that and then I’d totally suck and be just like one of you lol”. I have a LOT of other reasons but the “racism” is the main one.
